scheme.name: Shramik Basera Yojana (GBOCWWB)
scheme.summary: Provides accommodation facilities to registered construction workers in temporary prefabricated housing with basic amenities.
eligibility: Construction workers registered with the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Worker’s Welfare Board and their families.
The registered worker must present their identity card/smart card (e-Nirman card) renewed on time.
scheme.benefits: Accommodation facilities provided to laborers/workers at ₹5 per day.
scheme.how_to_apply: Registered construction workers can avail benefits by visiting the prefabricated temporary accommodation constructed near their workplace or Kadianaka.
